result_1_projection_fixed_point_obstruct.name: JANUS Projection Fixed-Point Obstruction
proof: Assume x is in Fix(F), so F(x)=x.
Using q∘F=G∘q gives G(q(x))=q(x), hence q(x) is in Fix(G).
Therefore if Fix(G) is empty, Fix(F) must also be empty.
result_1_projection_fixed_point_obstruct.scope: Pure fixed-point mathematics. Physical relevance requires q to represent a genuine retained state observable/register and the intertwining relation q∘F=G∘q to be physically justified.
result_1_projection_fixed_point_obstruct.statement: Let F:X->X, q:X->Y and G:Y->Y satisfy q∘F = G∘q. If Fix(G) is empty, then Fix(F) is empty.

result_2_independent_future_match_bound.classical_statement: At PRE_RETURN freeze time R, let V_R be the complete classical information available to the candidate process and let B_R be fixed/measurable from V_R. Let a later target T satisfy classical conditional min-entropy H_inf(T|V_R) >= h. Then Pr[B_R=T] <= 2^-h.
result_2_independent_future_match_bound.critical_boundary: The entropy premise cannot be proven merely by a signature or by a simulator that controls the entropy authority. It requires external/hardware and procedural trust separation plus entropy audit.

hard_identity_layer.reason: Semantic-class entropy is excluded unless its own conditional min-entropy is independently established.

result_2_independent_future_match_bound.interpretation: The hard witness is exact future-information identity under independently established conditional unpredictability, not semantic similarity or a post-selected correlation.
result_2_independent_future_match_bound.multiple_trials: For N preregistered trials, the union bound gives Pr[at least one exact match] <= N*2^-h.

result_3_bootstrap_vs_independent_future.name: JANUS Bootstrap/Independent-Future Separation
result_3_bootstrap_vs_independent_future.operational_requirement: A candidate is promoted beyond STRUCTURAL_MATCH only if future target generation is externally separated from the candidate process and its conditional unpredictability relative to the PRE_RETURN view is independently supported.
result_3_bootstrap_vs_independent_future.statement: An exact self-consistent copy B_return=B_send is not evidence of independent future information if the future target is causally derived from, seeded by, or otherwise dependent on the earlier return state.
